note: The checked-in tiny config uses indexer_budget=8, which starts sparse top-k at token 10 and makes a near-tied block choice sensitive to the vision oracle's 1e-6 rounding. The release config uses budget=2048. This video semantics gate uses budget=16 so its 12-token prompt remains below the release sparse-selection boundary; sparse QSA remains covered by the separate long-context selector gate.
